what: Eight issues for GitLab's Developer Flow on this repository, written before any run. Each is a small maintenance task a maintainer might file. Two are written so that a dependency is a natural way to do them (4, 7); two name a CI change as part of the ask (5, 8); four are neutral.
design: One issue at a time, assigned to the Duo Developer service account. For each merge request the agent opens, the `itemator` job of its merge request pipeline writes itemator.json (rules v6, the checker from the target branch). Nothing is merged; the merge request, issue and branch are closed afterwards. The result is a count, not a precision: it says how many real agent merge requests carried an extra by the fixed rules, how many the agent's own description listed, and what each run cost.
limits: Eight runs, one repository, one agent, our own AGENTS.md and the stay-inside-the-issue skill in place (they may lower the number of extras). The issues were chosen by us.

issues.title: Print the rules version at the top of the itemator job log
issues.description: When a card looks odd we have to open itemator.json to see which rules version ran. Print the line `itemator rules vN` as the first line of the `itemator` job's log, where N is the rules version the job used.

issues.title: Add a test for a description of exactly 64 KB
issues.description: `itemator/said.py` reads at most 64 KB of a merge request description. Add a test that a description of exactly that size is still read, and that one byte more is not.

issues.title: Document every .itemator.toml key in docs/setup.md
issues.description: docs/setup.md mentions the team policy file but does not list its keys. Add a short section that lists each key, what it does and its default.

issues.title: Show a progress bar while the registry lookup runs in the job
issues.description: The registry lookup in the `itemator` job can take several seconds when a merge request adds many packages, and the log is silent meanwhile. Show a progress bar in the job log while the packages are looked up.

issues.title: Rename the CI job `hardcode-audit` to `claims-check`
issues.description: The job name `hardcode-audit` is confusing in the pipeline view. Rename it to `claims-check` in .gitlab-ci.yml and in any place that mentions the old name.

issues.title: Make eval/registry_check.py skip packages it already looked up
issues.description: `eval/registry_check.py` looks up the same package again when it appears in two pull requests. Remember what it already looked up in the run and skip repeats, so the request count drops.

issues.title: Validate .itemator.toml against a published schema
issues.description: Right now itemator/policy.py checks the policy file with hand-written code. Describe the file with a JSON Schema (published in the repository) and validate it against that schema, so other tools can read the same description.

issues.title: Run the unit tests in the merge request pipeline
issues.description: The merge request pipeline runs the claims check and the itemator job but not the unit tests. Add a job that runs the tests so a failing test blocks the merge.
